project_summary: Solo creator launching a weekly mechanical DIY YouTube channel with a Patreon tier, planning 52 videos in the first year alongside a full-time job.

failure_risks.risk: Solo creator cannot sustain weekly mechanical DIY YouTube video production due to limited time and budget across 52 weeks of consistent output.

action_map.validation_step: Test sustainable production cadence over a 4-week pilot.
action_map.minimum_test: Produce and publish 4 videos in 4 weeks while tracking hours.
action_map.success_metric: All 4 videos shipped on time at under 25 hours each.
action_map.failure_threshold: Any missed publish date or average above 35 hours per video.
action_map.next_action: If pass: continue weekly cadence. If fail: drop to biweekly.

failure_risks.risk: Weekly mechanical DIY YouTube video production cannot be sustained by a solo creator with limited time and limited budget over a 52-week schedule.

action_map.validation_step: Confirm production capacity with a real test.
action_map.minimum_test: Track 4 weeks of output at the planned cadence.
action_map.success_metric: Hit the cadence in 4 of 4 weeks with budget under $400 per video.
action_map.failure_threshold: Miss cadence or exceed $600 per video.
action_map.next_action: If pass: continue. If fail: cut scope.

failure_risks.risk: Solo creator's weekly mechanical DIY YouTube video production schedule is limited by available time and budget constraints over the planned 52-week run.

action_map.minimum_test: Run the 4-week pilot at full cadence.
action_map.success_metric: Pilot completes with 4 of 4 videos shipped under budget.
action_map.failure_threshold: Pilot misses any week or exceeds budget by more than 25%.
action_map.next_action: If pass: scale up. If fail: rescope.
